title: Fix composer compat.bitty range (W-103 D1)

description: Defect (proven live on scratch): lua/composer/init.lua trim uses string.match(s, "^%s*(.-)%s*$") which returns nil on the live phodopus engine (lsonar Capture arm has no backtracking for quantified-inner captures); the nil then throws at activation via M.parse_keys (line 800 path, #text on nil). Mock (wasmoon, real Lua) is unaffected, hence mock-green/live-dead. Scope: replace the (.-) trim with the portable two-gsub form; verify it is the sole (.-) in the file; audit sibling patterns (check_compat ^(%d+)%. is safe for well-formed versions, confirm do not change); add a Lua-level regression test asserting trim behavior incl. edge cases (empty, all-space, no-space). Also file the engine follow-up as a phodopus issue (Capture needs backtracking or a documented gap) — do NOT implement engine changes. Plan: W-103 D2. Minimal diff; English-only; repo gates green.
title: Fix composer trim for the phodopus engine (W-103 D2)
